return.text: The return is avoided loss of contribution: $413.3M a year is exposed once a withdrawal can bite, from about month 12, because TAVNEOS stays on the market while the hearing process runs. At a 5 points gain in the probability TAVNEOS stays approved, the expected avoided loss is $20.7M against $12.5M, a net $8.2M; break-even is 3.0 points (2.4 points to 3.6 points across the $10M to $15M range). No page prices that gain. If the FDA signals acceptance, the budget to fully fund the FDA-required trial, about $30.7M, is released (program $43.2M), whose break-even of 10.4 points is why it waits for that signal; most of the payoff lands after the 24-month window.

evidence.decider: regulator (FDA, CDER, in the TAVNEOS withdrawal hearing)

lands_because.text: The decider is the FDA's drug center, and the hearing record is the one channel it must read. Amgen's 10-Q lists postmarketing commitments or studies among the actions the FDA may take, and the offer fills a gap CDER itself documents: the randomized trial of at least five years the FDA required at approval, which also carries the efficacy commitment, has enrolled only 21 of a planned 300 patients. A funded, independently adjudicated trial plus a U.S. liver registry speaks to both of CDER's live concerns, the unreliable ADVOCATE data and the hepatotoxicity the label warns of, which Amgen's retrospective submissions (real-world evidence and a blinded re-adjudication) cannot.

cannot_tell.text: It cannot show the FDA ever accepting a sponsor's trial offer, new or already required, in lieu of withdrawal; no indexed precedent does, and the precedents cut against the move. In the closest case Genentech asked that Avastin's breast indication stay subject to a new confirmatory study, CDER framed the issue as withdrawal versus keeping the indication while the sponsor runs new studies, and the Commissioner withdrew it after the hearing. Makena was withdrawn after a hearing that discussed new studies, Pepaxto was withdrawn, Ukoniq was withdrawn with the hearing waived, and the only retentions on the record (LUMAKRAS, Leqembi) came through confirmatory trials the FDA itself required. Every precedent was an accelerated approval while TAVNEOS holds a full approval, so none is a direct match, and that cuts both ways. CDER's TAVNEOS notice says no new blinded re-adjudication can redeem ADVOCATE and warns against letting a drug stay on the market while the applicant gets another chance; no trial answers the untrue-statements ground. The probability, the hearing date and the weight of the CHMP recommendation stay unsized.

unresolved.topic: Whether the FDA postmarketing-commitment path has real probability given the untrue-statements ground
unresolved.cfo_position: The probability gain that carries the return is weaker than first allowed and no page prices it; the gated offer is a cheap option bought as downside protection, not an investment that clears a cost-of-capital test on evidence.
unresolved.decider_position: The 10-Q frames postmarketing commitments as an alternative outcome to withdrawal, so the chance is real but unsized, and it is zero if the untrue-statements ground alone carries the case.
unresolved.record_note: Sharpened by the precedent pages, not settled: no indexed withdrawal ended with a new trial accepted in lieu of withdrawal, Genentech's new-study offer on Avastin did not change the outcome, and CDER's TAVNEOS notice rejects re-adjudication and a further chance on the market, which supports the decider side; every precedent was an accelerated approval while TAVNEOS holds a full approval, which keeps the CFO's small nonzero option open.

unresolved.cfo_position: The Repatha prior-authorization pilot has the better cost-of-capital case because its break-even can be measured from CMS formulary and 10-Q data, while the TAVNEOS offer rests on a probability no page can price.
unresolved.decider_position: After the gross-points correction the prior-authorization pilot no longer survives as a priced proposal, and payers kept prior authorization through earlier rebates; the gated TAVNEOS offer is the strongest survivor.

unresolved.cfo_position: The lift is unsourced: it carries the whole return and flips the sign when halved.
unresolved.decider_position: The lift is unattributable: management already runs the primary-care push, so no lift can be credited to new spend without a holdout.

unresolved.cfo_position: Unresolved: no contract terms are indexed, and on gross points the pilot does not clear its hurdle at the strategist's lift, so the unit can flip the sign.
unresolved.decider_position: Gross, by the 10-K convention that states deductions as a share of gross sales; on that basis the candidate's return is gone and no priced pilot is left.

unresolved.cfo_position: The floor is a discounted value of UCB's stream with growth stopping after the U.S. antibody patent expiry, roughly eight times trailing payments.
unresolved.decider_position: UCB's price sits above that discounted floor, closer to its undiscounted near-term stream; the decider is UCB, and nothing indexed shows it would sell at any price.
